target.title: fix(agents): memoize exec auto-reviewer verdicts for identical requests (#102249)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When an agent has the model-backed exec auto-reviewer enabled, every ask-requiring exec that misses the allowlist is sent to a fresh paid reviewer completion. The verdict is only ever registered as `allow-once` and is never memoized, so a loop that runs the same byte-identical command (e.g. `npm test`) pays for one reviewer completion per invocation.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add a per-run memo to `createModelExecAutoReviewer` that caches `allow-once` verdicts keyed on the `(command, argv, cwd, envKeys)` tuple. Since the reviewer uses `temperature: 0` and the prompt is a pure function of the request tuple, identical requests can safely reuse the cached verdict without changing security posture.

## User Impact

- Identical exec requests within a run reuse the cached verdict (0 additional paid completions)
- Different commands still get fresh reviewer completions
- `ask` and non-low-risk verdicts are not cached (conservative approach)
- No change for agents without the model-backed reviewer

## Evidence

- 13/13 tests pass in exec-auto-reviewer.test.ts (including new regression test)
- Format clean (oxfmt)

Fixes #102249
